scope: Individual indoor investigation request acknowledgement and physical coordinate consistency
findings: APPROACH could cancel a newly issued native doMove on its first callback while expectedDestination still held the original target. Explicit clearance already has a finite acknowledgement policy.
Investigation progress/arrival and reserved/failed node separation used ATL distances across different terrain cells, unlike existing absolute floor/body checks.
implementation: Capture native command/full destination/form leader and original server issue time immediately before actual doMove. Wait at most2seconds only for the unchanged original state or MOVE transition; no command replay, deadline renewal, visit or cleanup rights.
Measure all investigation progress and arrival in ASL; compare preconverted reserved/failed candidate positions in ASL. Native destinations and identity receipts remain ATL.
Existing ownership, contact, ignore-target, building-transform, actor availability and deadline checks remain ahead of the acknowledgement wait.
sourceIntent: Preserve useful native indoor movement while retaining bounded failed-point observations; no upstream code imported and no addon dependency added.
remaining: Native acknowledgement timing and actual repeated entry/exit remain unverified.
Read-only native positions/roof tests do not prove reachability of modded building nodes.
Full normal/actual-provider HC and measured overhead evidence remain missing.

terminalAuthority20261023.finding: CortexDiscover REAP can invoke FINISH after the worker FSM ends. FINISH validates the original native leg and saved finite deadline but previously did not use that deadline to bound a later doMove/doFollow return command. A matching native destination could therefore grant command authority long after the investigation episode.
terminalAuthority20261023.implementation: Native cleanup command authority now ends at the saved original server deadline plus30seconds, consistent with the finite naval-egress retirement window. All previous exact destination, group operation, actor and external-owner checks remain. Metadata retirement remains available after the cutoff; no new timer, worker, deadline renewal or native command is added.
terminalAuthority20261023.limitations: No native return-command acknowledgement protocol. An already-running unchanged native leg may remain after late metadata retirement. Does not prove smooth exit, formation or reliable physical handback. Whole clearance already uses separate exterior settlement and optional unchanged-route continuation; no broad claim of resolving historical wedge screenshots.
